name: dsh-agent-swarm
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-session multi-agent orchestration. The main agent recruits subagents, plans the orchestration (itself or by delegating planning to a subagent), executes, and summarizes. Host half provides ctx.swarm (a first-class service over ctx.subagents), a /swarm slash command, model-facing swarm context, and a loopback HTTP data plane; the client half adds a Swarm tab to the conversation view ring.
